candidate_sentence_map.S1: The company reported modest top-line growth during the first half of 2026, with consolidated revenue increasing by 0.6% to 28,590 thousand EUR compared to the same period last year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: This slight expansion was primarily driven by a strong recovery in the retail segment, which grew by 13.6% to account for 47.4% of total sales, offsetting a 9.1% contraction in wholesale revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Geographic contributions shifted notably, with Belarus emerging as a key growth driver while traditional markets faced headwinds from local currency depreciation and operational adjustments.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profitability metrics presented a mixed picture despite improved sales quality.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Gross profit rose by 5.3% to 15,892 thousand EUR, supported by a 4.8% reduction in the cost of goods sold and an expanded gross margin of 55.6%, up from 53.1%.

candidate_sentence_map.S12: Liquid resources strengthened considerably, with cash and short-term deposits totaling 51,150 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Liquidity ratios improved accordingly, with the current ratio rising to 10.3 and the quick ratio reaching 6.7.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Regional performance diverged across the Group’s primary markets.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Sales in Russia decreased slightly by 0.6% in EUR terms, while local currency revenues fell by 7.8%, leading management to prioritize retail profitability and reduce owned store locations to 67.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Belarus delivered resilient growth, with sales up 6.4% in EUR terms alongside positive local currency movements.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Declines were recorded in the Baltics and other international territories.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: To reinforce its balance sheet, the shareholder meeting resolved to retain the entire 2025 net profit within retained earnings rather than distribute dividends.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Overall, the reporting period reflected a strategic transition toward retail operations, disciplined cost control, and strengthened liquidity amidst fluctuating macroeconomic conditions in core markets.
